mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_outbox_replay_receipt(tenant_id,actor_key,request_key,event_id,request_hash,reason,ticket_ref) VALUES(#{tenant},#{actor},#{key},#{eventId},#{hash},#{reason},#{ticket}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_outbox_replay_receipt.id
mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,request_hash,result_version,result_replay_count FROM tc_outbox_replay_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_key=#{actor} AND request_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_outbox_replay_receipt SET result_version=#{version},result_replay_count=#{replayCount},completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND result_version IS NULL

UPDATE tc_outbox SET status='PENDING',publish_attempt_base=#{base},replay_count=replay_count+1,last_replayed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='REVIEW' AND version=#{version}
mapper.sql: FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status=#{state}
